recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-18346 unless future editorial policy changes the JSON formatting style across the page.
issue_request: FHIR-18346 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core technical correction for FHIR-core-extensibility. It asked to fix incorrect, likely tab-based, indentation in the JSON for the third extension example, the passport-number example.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit f54e2a4760e0d82d5cb51fe99bf84fc0438cb09f, which changed the misindented passport-number JSON lines in source/extensibility.html. A later general JSON formatting commit, 29f42c4294e2a08b2c329a3c849c294c21d434da, reformatted the extensibility page JSON examples while preserving the corrected block.
additional_context: source/extensibility.html is current build-scope source: source/fhir.ini maps the Extension type page to extensibility, and source/hierarchy.xml lists extensibility.html under the Extensibility page. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-18346, JSON indenting, and passport found no relevant or conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current passport-number JSON block in source/extensibility.html is consistently space-indented, contains no tabs in the reported block, and parses as valid JSON when extracted from the page source.
